plasmodb: Which P. vivax genes are likely to be membrane transporters? I want the ones that span the membrane multiple times.

Find Plasmodium genes involved in proteolysis that are expressed during gametocyte stages. Use both text annotations and GO term evidence for protease identification, then filter by gametocyte RNA-Seq expression percentile data.

Find P. berghei ANKA orthologs of P. falciparum 3D7 kinases expressed during gametocyte stages. Identify kinases two ways: genes with '*kinase*' in product descriptions of P. falciparum 3D7, and genes annotated with GO term kinase activity (GO:0016301) in P. falciparum 3D7 using both curated and computed evidence. Combine both sets. Then keep only those in the top 20% of expression in either male gametocyte or female gametocyte samples from the Lasonder/Bartfai gametocyte transcriptomes dataset, sense strand, protein-coding only. Finally, transform to P. berghei ANKA non-syntenic orthologs.
toxodb: Which Toxoplasma genes are turned on during the oocyst stage? I want the most dramatically upregulated ones.
Find Toxoplasma gondii genes that are bradyzoite-upregulated and likely secreted (signal peptide or secretion-related filters).

Find T. gondii ME49 candidate invasion proteins. Look for genes with cell-cycle expression patterns similar to known invasion genes MIC2 (TGME49_201780) and RON2 (TGME49_300100) using the M.White Cell Cycle microarray (Pearson correlation, top 500 similar genes, positive correlation), and combine both similarity sets. Keep only those that are secreted or membrane-associated (signal peptide or 1-7 transmembrane domains) across all T. gondii strains. Require mass spectrometry evidence (at least 1 peptide, 1 spectrum) from any T. gondii experiment. Finally, require a phylogenetic profile present in P. falciparum but absent from all mammals.
cryptodb: Find Cryptosporidium hominis genes with orthologs in Plasmodium falciparum but not in Toxoplasma gondii.
Find Cryptosporidium genes with signal peptides and intersect with genes annotated as secreted proteins. Suggest sanity checks to avoid over-filtering.
Find Cryptosporidium genes highly expressed in oocysts and enriched for membrane proteins (e.g. transmembrane domains).
piroplasmadb: Find predicted surface proteins (TM domains and annotation filters) for Theileria or Babesia. Propose the steps and combine operators to use.
Find Babesia genes with predicted secretion signals and blood-stage expression.
Find PiroplasmaDB genes with orthologs in Plasmodium falciparum and keep only those with known domains.
giardiadb: Find Giardia genes with orthologs in Cryptosporidium but not in Toxoplasma.
Find Giardia genes with signal peptides and intersect with cyst wall protein annotations. Include any parameter choices you recommend.
Find Giardia genes expressed in trophozoites and likely on the cell surface.
amoebadb: Find adhesion-related Entamoeba genes expressed in trophozoites, then filter for membrane features (e.g. transmembrane domains).
Find Entamoeba histolytica genes upregulated in cysts and likely secreted.
Find AmoebaDB genes with orthologs in Giardia and filter for transmembrane domains.
microsporidiadb: Find Microsporidia genes likely involved in host interaction (signal peptides or secreted annotations) and highly expressed in spores.
Intersect secreted-protein annotations with predicted membrane proteins for Microsporidia and suggest a validation step.
Find Microsporidia genes with orthologs in fungi and filter for conserved domains.
tritrypdb: Which Trypanosoma cruzi trans-sialidases are actually enzymatically active? I need to distinguish the active ones from the hundreds of pseudogenes.
Find Trypanosoma brucei genes upregulated in bloodstream forms and likely secreted.
Find TriTrypDB genes with orthologs in Trypanosoma cruzi and filter for transmembrane domains.
fungidb: I'm studying how Candida tropicalis forms filaments. Which filamentation genes have known protein structures?
Find C. albicans genes specifically upregulated during wild-type infection but not in a mutant. Use RNA-Seq differential expression data comparing infected vs in vitro conditions.

Find Cryptococcus neoformans H99 genes specifically upregulated in patient HC1 during human meningitis but not in patient G0. Use the Chen et al. meningitis RNA-Seq single-read dataset. First, find genes upregulated at least 2-fold (CSF vs YPD, minimum expression floor of 10 reads, protein-coding only) for each patient separately: G0 (G0 IN VIVO CSF vs G0 YPD) and HC1 (HC1 IN VIVO CSF vs HC1 YPD), both using minimum in reference and maximum in comparison. Then take HC1 upregulated genes and subtract G0 upregulated genes to get HC1-specific genes. Finally, remove genes also upregulated in ex vivo CSF (reference: G0 EX VIVO CSF, comparison: HC1 EX VIVO CSF, floor of 10 reads) from the paired-end dataset to exclude media effects.
hostdb: Find host immune genes upregulated during Plasmodium infection in blood. Suggest how to select the right studies and contrasts.
Find cytokine-activity genes expressed in macrophages and propose checks to avoid zero-result strategies.
Find HostDB genes with orthologs across mammals and filter for signal peptides.
vectorbase: Which mosquito immune proteins are secreted by hemocytes when the mosquito is infected with malaria parasites?
Find vector genes associated with insecticide resistance and intersect with genes expressed in the midgut. Suggest the best searches and parameters.
Find VectorBase genes with orthologs in Aedes and filter for transmembrane domains.
orthomcl: Find ortholog groups present in Plasmodium but absent in Cryptosporidium. Propose the step structure.
Find OrthoMCL groups shared between two species sets and include how to validate the result.
Find OrthoMCL groups that contain Plasmodium falciparum and Toxoplasma gondii orthologs.
veupathdb: Find T. gondii genes likely targeted to the apicoplast using comparative genomics. Use P. falciparum apicoplast GO annotations, transform to T. gondii orthologs, and subtract genes also conserved in Cryptosporidium which lacks an apicoplast.
Find studies about malaria transmission-blocking vaccines. Plan what to query for (keywords, filters, outputs) and build the strategy.
Find host transcriptomics studies involving Plasmodium falciparum and gametocytes.
